readiness.hed: Fredericksburg stays mild and mostly cloudy near 66 today, turns damp overnight with a slight rain chance, then a steadier rain system moves in Sunday into Sunday night before a mostly sunny, milder Monday near 70
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this morning. Today holds mostly cloudy near 66 with light east winds, and tonight brings only a slight 20 percent rain chance with a low near 49. Sunday turns wetter, with a 70 percent chance of rain and a high near 64, continuing into Sunday night with another 70 percent chance and a low near 50 as the system moves through. Monday clears out mostly sunny and a few degrees milder, near 70, before temperatures drop again Monday night to a low near 39.
actions: Sunday's steadier rain is the best bet of the weekend for washing out any outdoor plans — shift yard work, errands or a church outdoor event to today or Monday instead.
Tonight's slight rain chance is light enough to skip extra prep, but it's a good night to double-check gutters and drains before Sunday's heavier rain arrives.
Sunday night's continued rain chance means a wet Monday morning commute is possible even though Monday itself clears up — leave extra time and expect standing water on low-lying roads.
Monday's near-70 high is a good window for any outdoor chores before colder air returns Monday night, with lows back down near 39.
